asked.item: What 'This invoice can no longer be paid on Stripe' means
Must pay the old invoice before using Blotato again
Card was declined, what to do

verdict.reason: The help pages directly cover this exact invoice message, the declined card, and the need to pay the old invoice before resubscribing.

steps.text: The message "This invoice can no longer be paid on Stripe" means the invoice expired and Stripe closed it, so that specific invoice cannot be paid anymore.
You do not need to pay the old expired invoice.
Go to Settings > Billing and click View Billing Portal.
Update your payment method, and add a different card if your current card was declined.
Select the plan you want and confirm checkout; subscribing again generates a new invoice and reactivates your account.
